description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeCustomFieldAPI class in the OrangeHRM system. It verifies the behavior of methods such as retrieving and updating custom employee fields, including validation and permission checks.

classes.name: EmployeeCustomFieldAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing EmployeeCustomFieldAPI functionalities, including get, update, validation, and permission checks.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly provides an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies retrieving a single employee custom field, including permission checks and data normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the getOne method, including valid parameters and invalid credentials.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee's custom fields, ensuring data persists and permissions are respected.

methods.name: testUpdateWithoutPermission
methods.description: Ensures that updates are forbidden if the user lacks proper permissions.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the rules for updating an employee's custom fields, including handling invalid parameters.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that delete operation is not implemented and raises the correct exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Confirms delete validation rules are not implemented and raise the expected exception.
